definition: A sakin letter merges into an identical letter that follows it (for example قد دخلوا, ربحت تجارتهم); the waw and yeh of madd are not merged.
limitations: Paraphrase of the cited pages by an automated drafter; not scholarly reviewed.
Only Book A is cited; the printed page is where the section begins and needs proofreading.
The article lam and the meem-meem case are handled by other rules.

conditions.description: The first letter has no sign and the next letter, the same, has a shadda.
